name: Texas Lotto Generator
shortDescription: Simulate Texas Lottery draws with real-time animated ball machine and confetti celebration

suggestion.prompt: Create a lotto number generator. Have a pulldown of all the Texas lotto drawing configurations. Display the numbers real-time as if they are being drawn at that moment. Have a confetti celebration after the numbers are displayed as if those were the actual winning numbers.

generation.notes: All 8 major Texas Lottery games included. Animated ball machine with bouncing balls. One-at-a-time draw reveal with pop animation. Full confetti celebration on draw complete. Mobile-first responsive design.
